scope: Proposition 9.13 (Identification of the boundary problem) of the manuscript “Self-dual random-cluster interfaces below one” (preprints/Self-dual-random-cluster-interfaces-below-one-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 bf15a86507a10184), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 166. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose h is a locally uniform subsequential limit of hn, holomorphic in the ordinary complex coordinate, and along the same subsequence rn → r. Assume the boundary residual conclusion of Lemma 9.10. Then 0 < r < 1, and h maps Ω conformally onto the strictly convex quadrilateral with successive vertices 0, U0 = r + d(1 − r), T0 = r + y(1 − r), yV0 = y(dr + 1 − r). (9.84) It extends continuously to the boundary and takes p, b, c, d0 to those vertices, respectively.
